in_hebrew.name: מעכה
in_hebrew.meaning: מעכה - מלכה או מלכה האמהות, האשה הראשונה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: מעכה היא שם עברי שפירושו 'מלכה' או 'מלכה האמהות'. השם נגזר מהשורש 'עכ' שפירושו 'לקבוע, להקים' והסיומת '-ה' שפירושו 'האשה'. מעכה הייתה אשתו של דוד המלך ואם לבניו של דוד.

in_greek.name: Μααχά
in_greek.meaning: Μααχά - βασίλισσα ή μητέρα, πρώτη γυναίκα
in_greek.long_meaning: Η Μααχά είναι ένα ελληνικό όνομα που προέρχεται από την Εβραϊκή γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'βασίλισσα' ή 'μητέρα'. Το όνομα Μααχά αναφέρεται στη Βίβλο ως η σύζυγος του βασιλιά Δαβίδ και μητέρα των υιών του.

in_latin.name: Maacah
in_latin.meaning: Maacah - regina vel mater, prima uxor
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Maacah derivatur ex lingua Hebraea et significat 'regina' vel 'mater'. Maacah fuit uxor regis Davidis et mater filiorum eius. Nomen hoc in traditione christiana significat matrem et reginam virtutum.

in_english.name: Maacah
in_english.meaning: Queen or mother, first wife of King David
in_english.long_meaning: The name Maacah originates from Hebrew and means 'queen' or 'mother'. In the Bible, Maacah was one of the wives of King David and the mother of his children. The name holds significant spiritual meaning in Christian tradition, symbolizing maternal love, strength, and royalty. It reflects the virtues of a devoted mother and a righteous queen.

biblical_reference.note: Maacah was one of the wives of King David and the mother of Absalom.

data.cultural_impact: Maacah's name carries a negative connotation in Jewish and Christian traditions due to her role in leading the people of Judah to idolatry. Her name is associated with chaos, madness, and despair, which can be seen in the biblical narrative of her son, King Asa, who eventually ousted the idolatrous priests and restored the temple and altar of God.
data.spiritual_significance: Maacah's name serves as a reminder of the destructive power of idolatry and the importance of keeping faith in God. It underscores the importance of recognizing and turning away from negative influences in our lives and recommitting ourselves to the path of righteousness. Her story also highlights the power of redemption and the chance for individuals, regardless of their past, to make amends and rebuild their relationship with God.
